title: Will Cristiano Ronaldo play tonight in Al Nassr vs Al Kholood Saudi Pro League 2026-27 clash?
text:

 Will Cristiano Ronaldo play tonight in Al Nassr vs Al Kholood Saudi Pro League 2026-27 clash?
 By Rajarshi Shukla Follow Add as Preferred Source Rajarshi has been part of Khel Now since 2022, and he covers world football. Published at : October 29, 2026 at 2:50 PM (GMT+5:30) Modified at : October 29, 2026 at 2:50 PM (GMT+5:30) (Courtesy :  Getty )
 Al-Nassr have had two recent matches postponed due to regional security concerns
 In matchweek 12 of the Saudi Pro League, Al-Nassr will face Al Kholood at Al Awwal Park in an attempt to prolong their winning streak.
 Al-Nassr have had a great start to the league season, winning eight of their first ten games to earn 25 points. This puts them in second place in the standings, tied with third-place Al Qadsiah and two points behind leaders Al Hilal.
 Given their present performance and record in this match—having won three and drawn one of their four prior encounters with Al Kholood—the hosts will be optimistic about extending that run.
 Will Cristiano Ronaldo play tonight?
 Catch Every Update, Anytime, Anywhere
 Cristiano Ronaldo of team Al Nassr FC celebrates after scoring (Courtesy: Getty) 
 After Monday’s crucial AFC Champions League match was postponed, Cristiano Ronaldo will play for Al Nassr tonight. He is fully fit and has been training alongside the team. 
 Due to the current hostilities in adjacent Yemen, Cristiano Ronaldo’s return to action has recently been disrupted by the two postponed matches. It comes after a missile fired by Houthi troops struck Riyadh airport on October 10, killing thirteen people.
 The match between the defending Saudi Pro League champions and Al Ahli has been rescheduled for March 2027. The AFC Champions League clash against Al Wasl has also been postponed. 
 The five-time Ballon d’Or winner led Al Nassr to a 3-1 victory over Al-Faisaly last Friday. The Portuguese star netted his fifth goal of the season after heading the ball home and also contributed an assist.
 In their attempt to win the Saudi Pro League again, Al Nassr’s victory put them in second position, two points behind rivals Al Hilal. Ronaldo has continued his goalscoring spree and will hope to add more to his name tonight.
 Will Cristiano Ronaldo play tonight?
 Yes, he will play tonight.
 Where do Al Nassr stand in the table?
 They are second in the table.
